title: Full Calendar (Remastered)
description: A professional, extensible calendar engine for the Obsidian knowledge management platform. Seamlessly integrates local markdown event notes with remote CalDAV and ICS feeds, built with an offline-first data integrity architecture.
highlights: Multi-provider calendar engine (CalDAV, Google / Apple ICS, local markdown)
Interactive agenda, day, week, month, and timeline scheduling views
Two-way synchronization with YAML frontmatter data validation
